_readme: FIAT ON THE AIR (14 Oct, docs/design/on_the_air.md): three scenes, 640x360, shown at 3x drifting. art/intro/.
Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_air_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run; one wrong: ++ --only <name> ++ --force).

jobs.description: The corner of a makeshift camp at night under a tarpaulin: a green army field radio set on a table made from a pallet, its dials and small lamps glowing amber, a pair of headphones and a coiled handset, a chipped mug, a notepad. Through a gap in the tarpaulin, the camp's brazier and two vans, and beyond them the dark outline of a dead British town. The radio is the brightest thing in the picture. Realistic painted pixel art, wide cinematic composition with room to pan, soft light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, Britain; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos, no readable writing.

Britain at night from a hillside above a motorway: below, a large dark city with only a few scattered fires burning, no streetlights; the motorway empty except for a long line of army lorries with their headlights on, the only lights moving; far off on the horizon another city, just as dark. Cold, vast, quiet. Realistic painted pixel art, wide cinematic composition with room to pan, soft light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, Britain; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos, no readable writing.

A table at night lit by a single torch: old paperwork spread out - a betting slip, a pawn ticket, a bank statement, a council letter - with numbers circled and ringed in pencil, a notepad with columns of frequencies, a stub of pencil; at the edge, the dial of an army radio set glowing amber. Close and intimate, the dark all around. Realistic painted pixel art, wide cinematic composition with room to pan, soft light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, Britain; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos, no readable writing.
